cohort: Exact preceding 329-recording curve comparison; 241 train/gallery, 43 validation, 45 test; no new exclusion
split: Two independent directions: train/validate only search view A and encode A for A-to-B retrieval; train/validate only search view B and encode B for B-to-A retrieval. All judges are frozen opposite-view judges. Test recordings enter neither training nor checkpoint selection.
units: Individual existing 17-point F, P, H0, H1, H2 curves, not averages across segments. Same complete-view spans and maximum 32 curves per type/recording.
input: 7 centered normalized performance channels; 3 score tension curves with explicit validity; relative position; log original-score-interval duration; five type indicators. P context interpolation uses the same written-quarter midpoints as its performance curve.
scaling: Input and supervised lag target scales fit only on train recordings/search view, balanced by family/work/recording/type/curve. Existing catalog common-pattern normalization is unchanged and remains a candidate-included reference.
architecture: Separate performance and score-context Conv1d projections, three width-32 dilated residual blocks, order-preserving flatten, 32D segment embedding, projection and response/reconstruction heads; no decoder bypass of the embedding
primary: response_aux P/H/P+H embeddings; the other models are predeclared controls, not candidates selected by test score
reconstruction_only: Two differently masked inputs of the same observed segment; masked feature MSE only, equal five musical feature blocks
response: VICReg-like consistency on two mildly masked views, variance floor and covariance decorrelation; observed normalized Tempo/Dynamics differences, difference direction classes, observed maximum positions, and tension/performance lag correlations
response_aux: response objectives plus 0.1 times masked feature reconstruction loss
context_only: Same response_aux objective/architecture but performance values and performance validity always absent during training and inference; an actually trained score-only control
targets: Computed only from observed training curves. Shape: amplitude-normalized differences, not unique correct performances. Direction and maximum positions are empirical residual properties. Lag targets use only selected H metric and original 17-beat windows at -4..4 beats; no phase-normalized P lag labels.
augmentation: Hide two of 17 positions, all performance channels, independently in two views; preserve score context, order, level and amplitude; original targets never passed through hidden encoder positions
sampling: 4096 weighted draws per epoch, with replacement; equal family/work/recording/type importance. Validation uses all its search-view curves, fixed masks and those same hierarchical weights.
checkpoint: Minimum validation weighted training objective, never retrieval test scores; log initial and trained losses plus per-target errors and latent spread
retrieval: Individual 32D segment embeddings; same symmetric nearest-segment distance, train-only per-coordinate scaling and train-other-family median calibration. Equal H metrics and P/H weights. B+P+H uses equal squared-distance thirds, reported separately to retain global level/width.
evaluation: All seven preceding opposite-view judges E-L/E-T/E-R/E-S/E-PC/E-PN/E-HL, same exact arrays and gallery/query indices
controls: five fixed independent performance-point permutation seeds with score context fixed and actual embedding metric calibration frozen
same returned work/grid random recording exact expectation
limitations: One training seed in this first pilot
Validation recordings select checkpoint, so validation retrieval is not untouched evidence
Only three test and three validation families
No human style labels or verified phrase/tension episodes
Observed-response targets partly share constructs with numeric judges on disjoint views; this is proxy learning, not independent perceptual validation
A centered residual is not proven pure performer style
